base:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable full-body pose reference for personalized children's book, isolated transparent PNG.
Input images: image 1 is the existing page 28 gray-bodysuit character, identity/proportions/style reference; image 2 is approved page 7 gray character, finish/style reference; image 3 is page 28 background for story direction only, do not include background in output.
Create ONE new pose of the same bald gray child in a plain gray bodysuit, with eyebrows. Oversized rounded head, small body and limbs, simple expressive eyes, small triangle nose, subtle paper/gouache grain, soft gray shading, restrained thin outline. Match reference character proportions exactly.
Narrative: child has decided "Not yet" about the slide and warmly lets another child go first. Child stands calmly on a level wooden platform, both feet planted. Body three-quarter front, subtly angled toward slide entrance on image LEFT. Head turns to image RIGHT to make eye contact with the smaller waiting child off-screen there, gaze slightly down-right. Small confident friendly smile, relaxed brows. ONE arm extends gently toward image LEFT at waist level, elbow softly bent, open upward-facing palm inviting the other child to take the slide. Other arm rests naturally. Gesture should read "you go first", not waving, pointing, fear, or a stop sign.
Framing: entire character visible including both feet and complete open hand, generous transparent margin, head near upper center, clean anatomy. No other person, no props, no slide, no ground, no backdrop, no text. Real alpha transparency, preserve white eye areas opaque. Gray face and gray hands as in base references; no hair, colored clothing, accessories, or cast shadow. Ideally native 2048 square if available.
personalizedPreview:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent full-body personalized character preview for a children's picture book.
Image 1 is pose target. Image 2 is exact colored character identity and illustration style reference.
Recreate image 1 in color with the child from image 2. Preserve image 1 pose: upright feet planted, head looking screen RIGHT, friendly calm small smile, relaxed brows, one arm extended screen LEFT at waist height, palm open facing up in gentle "you go first" invitation; other arm down. Keep head/body proportions and gesture unchanged.
Identity from image 2: warm tan skin, short side-swept brown hair, large brown eyes, triangular nose, soft peach cheeks, blue short-sleeve T-shirt, blue-gray shorts, light-blue sneakers with white soles. Same gentle paper/gouache grain, restrained outlines, same child age and oversized head.
Full figure, both shoes and entire extended hand visible, transparent margins. ONE child only. Genuine transparent alpha background, no background, other person, props, text, ground, shadow, or added decorations. White eye areas opaque. Ideally native 2048 square if available.
